subject: PharmaLabs: on-prem / air-gapped deployment questionnaire and evidence request
messages:
From: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@pharmalabs.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-04-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: PharmaLabs: on-prem / air-gapped deployment questionnaire and evidence request

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for taking this — PharmaLabs is evaluating private deployment options for an FDA-regulated workload. To progress the RFP we need:  

- Completed deployment capability questionnaire (attached template).
- Evidence: operator runbook (day-to-day ops), patching cadence and SBOM, KMS/HSM integration notes and key management flow diagrams.
- Details on offline/air-gapped update procedures and emergency vulnerability patch process.
- Typical support window, escalation path and SLAs for isolated installs.
- A short attestation letter covering data residency and encryption-in-transit/at-rest for private deployments.

We aim to complete vendor evaluations by 2027-05-06. Can you confirm whether you can supply the requested artifacts and if a 90-minute technical workshop next week is possible?

Attaching a copy of our RFP for context.

Thanks,

Alex Mercer
Director, IT Security
PharmaLabs Inc.
Attachments: PharmaLabs_RFP_20270422.pdf
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@pharmalabs.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-22T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PharmaLabs: on-prem / air-gapped deployment questionnaire and evidence request

Alex — thanks for the clear ask and the RFP. We can absolutely support private / air-gapped deployments for regulated workloads and will get you the artifacts you listed. High-level plan:  

1) Deliver a filled questionnaire and an initial evidence pack by 2027-04-26 (includes runbook outline, SBOM summary, and KMS integration notes).
2) Schedule a 90-minute technical workshop (we suggest Tue/Wed next week); agenda: architecture walkthrough, operator controls, patch/update playbook, and Q&A.
3) Provide an attestation letter signed by our Head of Security within 48 hours after we validate the deployment configuration with your team.

Attached: redwood_initial_response_matrix.xlsx — this is our working matrix; we’ll populate more detail in the next 48 hours. A couple of quick answers inline below:  

- KMS/HSM: We support customer-managed KMS for key wrapping; HSM integrations are available for Dedicated and Private customers (we’ll include keyflow diagrams).
- Patching cadence: default quarterly for non-urgent updates; emergency security patches can be applied via offline bundle with documented verification checks (we’ll attach the verification checklist).
- Operator access: role-based access for operators with audited console sessions; operator accounts can be scoped to the customer VPC.

Would you prefer the workshop as a recorded session for your internal compliance team? Also, do you require an NDA before we share network diagrams and the full SBOM?

Best,

— Soojin Lee
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.ai
Attachments: redwood_initial_response_matrix.xlsx

Date: 2027-04-23T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PharmaLabs: on-prem / air-gapped deployment questionnaire and evidence request

Thanks Soojin — the plan sounds good. A few follow-ups before the workshop:  

- We need more granular detail on egress controls and how you enforce zero outbound for air-gapped installs (what telemetry/health checks, if any, are optional and how are they disabled).
- For offline patch bundles, please describe the signing/verification model and whether customers can run their own verification in their airgap.
- Operator access: will your operators ever need standing credentials into our VPC? If yes, we need the exact access model and justification.

One administrative note: PharmaLabs requires an internal NDA before vendors can receive network topology diagrams and SBOMs. I’ve attached our network requirements doc and will send an NDA for signature if you confirm.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept our NDA (I'll route to our legal team) and confirm proposed workshop slots?

Regards,

Alex Mercer
Director, IT Security
PharmaLabs Inc.
Attachments: pharmalabs_network_requirements.pdf
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Mercer <alex.mercer@pharmalabs.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-04-23T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: PharmaLabs: on-prem / air-gapped deployment questionnaire and evidence request

Alex — thanks for the clarifying questions. We can accept your NDA; please send the DocuSign link and we’ll route to legal immediately. Proposed workshop windows (Pacific time):

- Tue, 2027-04-27 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed, 2027-04-28 13:00–14:30 PT

Agenda (90 min):
- 15m: introductions + compliance goals
- 30m: architecture & deployment model (air-gap, VPC controls, egress policing)
- 20m: patch/update playbook and bundle verification
- 15m: operator access model and audit trail
- 10m: next steps & artifact delivery schedule

Inline responses to your items:
- Egress/telemetry: telemetry is optional — we provide a verification-only heartbeat you can choose to run locally; default air-gapped mode has zero external network calls. We’ll include a toggles matrix in the runbook.
- Offline bundles: bundles are cryptographically signed by Redwood and include an embedded hash tree; customers may verify signatures with a provided public key and can re-sign with their HSM.
- Operator access: Redwood operators do not retain standing credentials into customer VPCs. For Private installs we support a break-glass process that requires signed change requests, timeboxed access, and session recording.

Attached is a short ops-runbook outline and an updated response matrix — we’ll populate the network diagrams after NDA.

If those workshop times work, Ben will send a calendar invite and we’ll prepare the detailed artifacts for delivery on 2027-04-26.

— Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Attachments: redwood_ops_runbook_outline.pdf
